diagnosis: The shared context guarantees that all three specialists will read their findings aloud, so the principal can pass every content check by simply following the stated routine and asking everyone. This leaks the otherwise private facts through the generic 'just ask everyone' procedure.
evidence: S5 and S6 require the facilities manager, business office manager, and school nurse to state their findings aloud in order before the review can close.
fix_instructions: Remove the guaranteed read-aloud procedure from shared_context, or make specialist disclosure contingent on targeted requests or unresolved issues that the principal cannot know from the shared view.
